map.给定信号最高频率 f_max，求无混叠所需的最低采样率 f_s ≥ 2·f_ma: Given the highest signal frequency f_max, find the minimum sampling rate fs >= 2 f_max required to avoid aliasing.
map.无失真重建连续信号所需最小采样率为信号最高频率的两倍。: The minimum sampling rate to reconstruct a continuous signal without distortion is twice the highest signal frequency.
map.20 kHz 音频需 ≥40 kHz 采样（CD 为 44.1 kHz）。: 20 kHz audio requires >=40 kHz sampling (CD uses 44.1 kHz).
map.最高频率 fmax 的两倍即最低无混叠采样率。: Twice the highest frequency fmax is the minimum alias-free sampling rate.
map.对比不同 fmax 的采样要求。: Compare sampling requirements for different fmax.
map.奈奎斯特率 fs = 2 × 20000 = 40000 Hz = 40 kHz: Nyquist rate fs = 2 x 20000 = 40000 Hz = 40 kHz; CD samples at 44.1kHz for margin.
map.若 fmax=1MHz，则至少需 2MHz 采样，否则高频混叠到低频。: If fmax=1MHz, at least 2MHz sampling is needed, otherwise high frequencies alias into low frequencies.
map.实际采样率要正好 2fmax 吗？: Should the actual sampling rate be exactly 2fmax?
map.应高于 2fmax 并加抗混叠滤波，留过渡带余量以防混叠。: It should be above 2fmax with an anti-aliasing filter, leaving transition-band margin to prevent aliasing.
map.采样不足时高频分量折叠成低频虚假分量，破坏信号真实性。: When sampling is insufficient, high-frequency components fold into false low-frequency components, destroying signal fidelity.
